title: Track the Select component under its PascalCase
notes: (case-insensitive APFS) and invisible on the production host too, because
`vexa-deploy` rsyncs the working tree, whose directory entry reads
`Select.tsx`. Any fresh clone on a case-sensitive filesystem fails
type-check with `TS1261 ... differs from file name ... only in casing`.
result: renamed the tracked file to `Select.tsx`, matching every sibling (`SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `SelectTrigger`) and the convention that a component file is named after its exported symbol.
evidence: surfaced by running `pnpm run check:ci` in a clean worktree, which is also what proved the fix — 540 tests green there afterwards.
